mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that triggers corporate earnings revisions downward, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad consumer demand contraction, which precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year window, or negative returns occur in less than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing slowdown that precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate output growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year periods.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers Fed rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 2.0%, it signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output that supports corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
